name: Jak and Daxter OpenGOAL
game: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
summary: Official OpenGOAL runtimes with Jak 1 game data extracted, validated, decompiled and compiled from your PS2 ISO by the release's own extractor.

first_run.summary: Jak 1 game data is extracted and compiled from your ISO during the build, and the launcher boots it directly.

release_rules.notes: Stable releases ship opengoal-linux-<tag>.tar.gz and opengoal-windows-<tag>.zip.

linux.description: Linux runtime; its extractor also builds the game data used by both packages.

inputs.label: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (USA) (Rev 1) PS2 ISO
inputs.notes: The extractor's own validation (-v) must also accept the disc.

source_checks.description: The release still contains the NTSC v1 decompiler configuration

operations.text:
{name} {version} portable package.
Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder, then run {launch_command}.
OpenGOAL runs in --portable mode with the compiled game data under data/out/jak1. Settings and saves stay in this folder.
Official upstream: https://github.com/{repository}
Packaging checks file structure only. Record startup or gameplay results separately for this exact download.

linux.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.sh. It starts gk in portable mode with the bundled compiled data.

windows.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.cmd.

saves: OpenGOAL's --portable flag keeps settings and saves in the package folder.

linux: x86-64 Linux with OpenGL graphics (runtime requirement published upstream)

limitations: The Windows package uses game data compiled by the Linux extractor of the same release. This matches the 2026-10-11 manual package and assumes the compiled data is platform-independent; it has not been confirmed on native Windows.
Extraction takes several minutes and roughly 2 GB of temporary space.

verified_releases.evidence: Manual 2026-10-11 package: Linux reached the title screen; Windows assembled, not launched (RomM 12965 / 12968).

history: 2026-10-11: first packages assembled with outputs/package-native-ports.py after running the extractor by hand. This definition automates the same steps.
